summary: Indiana Jones game entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Indiana Jones and the Fate of Atlantis
entries.definitive_edition: CD-ROM talkie PC version through ScummVM or current PC storefront package

emulation.notes: Use ScummVM for the retail talkie assets when possible; use DOSBox/storefront wrapper if matching package behavior.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original CD-ROM PC talkie assets with documented audio configuration

primary.version: CD-ROM talkie version through ScummVM or current PC storefront package
primary.why: The PC CD-ROM talkie route gives the complete voiced adventure while ScummVM or current storefront packaging makes it reliable on modern systems. Earlier floppy/computer releases are important history but not the simplest complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Use GOG/Steam or original CD assets through ScummVM. Record ScummVM/DOSBox version, audio device or MT-32/Sound Canvas path, aspect correction, subtitles/voice settings, and whether the three story paths were completed.

secondary.platform: Amiga / Macintosh / FM Towns / original DOS floppy
secondary.what_to_play: Use only for audio, palette, interface, or release-history comparison.
secondary.why: The CD-ROM talkie PC route is the complete main route.

secondary.platform: Wii unlockable in Indiana Jones and the Staff of Kings
secondary.what_to_play: Document as an access-path curiosity only.
secondary.why: It is not the best fidelity or preservation route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record wrapper, audio device, aspect settings, and whether the Team/Wits/Fists paths were all covered.

entries.title: Indiana Jones and the Great Circle
entries.definitive_edition: Current PC release with The Order of Giants DLC installed

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current PC build with graphics and DLC state documented

primary.version: Current PC release with The Order of Giants DLC
primary.why: The PC release is the most flexible high-fidelity route for MachineGames' first-person Indiana Jones adventure, with settings/capture control and current DLC support. Xbox Series X|S, PS5, and Switch 2 are all official routes, but PC is the cleanest archive path.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current PC release from Steam/Microsoft Store/Bethesda ecosystem with The Order of Giants installed if covering complete story content. Record build, ray/path-tracing settings, controller or keyboard/mouse, difficulty, chapter, collectable state, DLC state, and whether Xbox/PS5/Switch 2 versions were compared.

secondary.why: PC is more capture-flexible, but Xbox is the original console route.
They are current official routes, but not the primary PC archive path.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record graphics, patch, and DLC state; do not merge with older Indiana Jones adventure games.
